item.title: MiBeeNvr v0.7.0: Timelapse v2 and the Hard-Fix Release
item.description:
After v0.6.0 shipped the timelapse pipeline, community feedback quickly listed the hard problems: an intermediate JPEG sequence ate too much space; H.265 cameras produced unplayable timelapse segments; dual-lens Xiaomi devices could only grab the main lens; and H.265 live view occasionally crashed outright.

Timelapse that actually works

  • Merging no longer goes through intermediate images: much smaller footprint, and the merged output is directly playable video
  • Timelapse segments from H.265 cameras play properly now
  • Merge windows come in selectable tiers (8 hours to 30 days) instead of a fixed daily run
  • Timelapse and regular recordings share one list — no flipping between two pages

Dual-lens Xiaomi, lens selectable

  • Dual-lens devices like the CW500 and Outdoor Cam 4 can target a specific lens
  • Chosen in the web UI, effective immediately

Steadier

  • The H.265 live-view crash is thoroughly fixed
  • The transcoding module was refactored into layers — adding new encoders or hardware no longer ripples through the whole pipeline

Fix what hurts first.
